name: Paper
one_liner: Agent-native design canvas built on real HTML/CSS, with a read/write MCP server and React/Tailwind export.
what_it_offers: A collaborative design tool (web app plus Paper Desktop for macOS ARM, Windows x64, and Linux AppImage/Deb/RPM) whose canvas renders actual HTML/CSS. You can paste from Figma, snapshot live webpages into editable layers (Paper Snapshot), use design tokens, edit vectors with a pen tool, apply shader filters, and export JSX/Tailwind or PDF. Video export is Pro-only. Paper Desktop runs a local MCP server with 21 read/write tools (get_jsx, get_computed_styles, get_screenshot, write_html, update_styles, create_artboard, and more) so Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Copilot, and others can see and edit designs.
tech_stack: Web-standards (HTML/CSS) canvas; exports React JSX + Tailwind; desktop app plus web app; open-source @paper-design/shaders-react (Apache-2.0)
portfolio_fit_reason: A design canvas built on real HTML/CSS, with MCP read/write and JSX/Tailwind export, lets portfolio layouts and case-study pages move straight from design into code with AI agents. It is a general tool, not portfolio-specific.
client_ok_note: The ToS (2026-03-30) says Paper claims no ownership of your content and does not restrict commercial use of exports. The shaders library is Apache-2.0.
best_use_for_portfolio: Lay out the portfolio home, project grid and case-study template in Paper, seeding it with Snapshot captures of reference portfolios. Have a coding agent pull the structure and styles over MCP into a Next.js + Tailwind build. Use @paper-design/shaders-react for an animated hero background.
tier_reason: A canvas built on real HTML and CSS, with MCP read/write and JSX/Tailwind export, moves portfolio layouts from design into agent-built code. It is general-purpose.
pick_over_overlaps: Choose it over Framer when the site will live in your own React/Tailwind repo.
score_rationale: An excellent fit for code-first builders working with AI coding agents: designs are real HTML/CSS, agents read and write the canvas over MCP, and JSX/Tailwind export shortens design-to-code. It is a tool, not a source of taste, so how distinctive the result looks still depends on the designer's direction. The free plan's 100 MCP calls a week is tight for agent-heavy work, and the product is still pre-1.0.
free_tier: $0: unlimited viewers and editors, 100 MCP tool calls per week, limited image generation, 25 MB max image size. No video export.
paid_entry_label: Pro $20/editor/mo billed monthly ($16/editor/mo billed yearly, save 20%). Includes 1M MCP tool calls/week, 100x more image gen, video export, and a 100 MB image limit.
paid_top_label: Pro $20/editor/mo (Organizations tier is custom pricing via sales: SAML/SSO, admin controls, custom contracts, dedicated support)
commercial_use_license: Proprietary SaaS operated by Lost Coast Labs, Inc. (dba Paper). Per the ToS (last updated 2026-03-30), Paper does not claim ownership of your content, and no clause restricts commercial use of your exported designs or code. The only commercial-exploitation ban covers the Service itself. You grant Paper a broad, perpetual, sublicensable license to your content, limited to operating and providing the Service. AI-agent outputs are provided as-is, and you are solely responsible for using them. The separate shaders library (paper-design/shaders, @paper-design/shaders-react) is Apache-2.0.
agent_friendly: Strong. There is a local MCP server at http://127.0.0.1:29979/mcp that starts with Paper Desktop when a design file is open. It is documented for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, VS Code Copilot, Antigravity, and OpenCode. Read tools include get_jsx, get_computed_styles, get_screenshot, get_tree_summary, and export. Write tools include write_html, update_styles, create_artboard, and set_text_content. The site also has llms.txt, a public openapi.json, and the npm package @paper-design/shaders-react (Apache-2.0, v0.0.80).
maintenance_signal: Very active and well-funded. A $34M Series A led by Accel and ICONIQ was announced 2026-07-23 ($38.5M total raised). The build log shows releases through August 2026 (comments, free editors, desktop tabs, tokens in app). Desktop is at v0.5.9, released 2026-09-12. The paper-design/shaders repo has 3,448 stars and was last pushed 2026-09-04. The homepage says designers at Vercel, Perplexity, Tailwind, PostHog, Zed, and others use it in production.
caveats: MCP is local-only and requires Paper Desktop running with a file open. The free tier caps MCP at 100 tool calls per week, so heavy agent use needs Pro, and video export is Pro-only. The app is pre-1.0 (v0.5.9), so expect feature gaps versus Figma. Content is stored in a proprietary cloud with a broad service license. The Organizations tier has no public price.
unverified_fields: tech_stack (internal implementation beyond HTML/CSS canvas not documented)
